paragraphs: The XF 2.2 Diesel uses the Ford Duratorq I4 — a 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel unit fitted to the X250 generation from 2007 to 2015. This engine is part of Ford's Duratorq family, a widely-used diesel platform shared across several manufacturers of the era. The XF 2.2 Diesel was discontinued when the X260 generation replaced the X250 in 2015, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar XF 2.2 Diesel Engine Compatibility The Ford Duratorq I4 in the X250-generation XF is a belt-driven diesel engine, which means the timing belt requires regular interval replacement rather than lasting the lifetime of the engine. We replace the timing belt, injectors, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. Do you supply used XF 2.2 Diesel engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most XF 2.2 Diesel owners, yes. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XF 2.2 Diesel from 2023 to present. The Ford Duratorq I4 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford Duratorq I4 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford Duratorq I4 rebuild.
